report: Hydraulic hose burst on the implement lift. Oil on the ground. Mechanic is on site with a spare hose.
lesson: Before a hydraulic hose swap, contain and clean the oil spill and depressurise the lift circuit, and check the mounted disc_6 implement is safely lowered.
